items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: He wanted me to, he needed a bass player and wanted to know would I join the band... You know it worked out.

ctx.x: And I remember, I was going to Dave's Fifth Avenue on Saturday afternoon, because we worked at night and they had jam sessions on Saturday afternoons. (This remark cut off by tape.) Cal Tjader was working that day and on Saturday, that afternoon, I had gone over there and people were just lined up to get in. I got inside the room and I was standing, because the place was just jammed.
And Cal sounded...great artist and has sound. And it did something to me, like, wow, I just got to play different than what I'm playing. I got to play something. I got to play.
